bands.title: Minimal symptoms
bands.summary: Your answers fall in the PHQ-9's minimal range (0–4). Few low-mood symptoms have bothered you over the last two weeks.

bands.title: Mild symptoms
bands.summary: Your answers fall in the PHQ-9's mild range (5–9). Some low-mood symptoms have bothered you recently. Keep an eye on how you feel.

bands.title: Moderate symptoms
bands.summary: Your answers fall in the PHQ-9's moderate range (10–14). It would be a good idea to talk to a doctor or mental health professional about how you have been feeling.

bands.title: Moderately severe symptoms
bands.summary: Your answers fall in the PHQ-9's moderately severe range (15–19). Please consider speaking to a doctor or mental health professional soon.

bands.title: Severe symptoms
bands.summary: Your answers fall in the PHQ-9's severe range (20–27). Please reach out to a doctor or mental health professional as soon as you can. You deserve support.

support.text: A score of 10 or more is the point at which health professionals usually suggest a proper conversation about mood. Talking to a doctor, counsellor or someone you trust is a strong, positive step.

mood.low: Few symptoms of low mood have bothered you recently.
mood.moderate: Some symptoms of low mood have bothered you recently.
mood.high: Many symptoms of low mood have bothered you recently.
mood.reflect: What has been weighing on you most over the last two weeks?
mood.tip: Try to keep one small routine each day: a walk, a meal with someone, or a set bedtime.

suggestions: Low mood is common and treatable. Reaching out is a sign of strength.
Sleep, daylight, movement and contact with people you trust can all help a little each day.
Retake this check-in in two weeks to see how things change.
note: The PHQ-9 adds up your nine answers (Not at all = 0, Several days = 1, More than half the days = 2, Nearly every day = 3) for a score from 0 to 27. The ranges shown are the PHQ-9's official severity ranges. A PHQ-9 score is a screening result only. It cannot diagnose depression; only a qualified professional can do that.
